info.title: Atrium LMS API
info.description: Phase 15 API contract. Authentication, RBAC, catalog, learning, assessments, certificates, notifications, announcements, and role-scoped analytics are documented. Path-level summaries describe each endpoint; request schemas are documented where Zod registration exists.
